BiblicalUsage: Pterna means the heel. It appears once, at the last supper: Jesus says, I speak not of you all, I know whom I have chosen, but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with Me hath lifted up his heel against Me.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the lifted heel is the deepest betrayal in the Bible: not an enemy's sword but a friend's foot, at the table, over bread.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
